tools.name: get_idea
tools.description: Fetch an idea, including match and settlement state. Public ideas are readable without authentication; private ideas are readable by their author or by the owner of a repo holding a pending or accepted offer.

tools.name: list_my_ideas
tools.description: List the authenticated caller's Dibs ideas with lifecycle phase/status.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List registered repository venues known to Dibs.

tools.name: submit_idea
tools.description: Create a Dibs idea owned by the authenticated caller. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_idea" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
